comparison.objective: Fit two rings onto a stepped shaft in the only order permitted by their bores; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced bore-to-shaft alignment and sliding insertion, not hammer-actuated notch fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Both rings are fitted in bore-compatible order; seating thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Despite coaxial placement, the central ability is order-constrained assembly, with no fracture, impact regulation, coil retention, or fragment recovery.
